tools.name: archive_retired_flag_definition
tools.description: Moves a retired feature flag's definition file out of the active flags directory into the archive directory, under a timestamped filename. The flag stops being loaded by services that read the active directory.

params.name: flag_key
params.description: Key of the retired feature flag, e.g. 'checkout_v2_banner'.

params.name: environment
params.description: Environment whose flag directory holds the definition, e.g. 'staging' or 'production'.

tools.code:
import shutil
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path

from agents import function_tool

FLAG_CONFIG_ROOT = Path("/srv/feature-flags")


@function_tool
def archive_retired_flag_definition(flag_key: str, environment: str) -> dict:
    active_flags_directory = FLAG_CONFIG_ROOT / environment / "active"
    archived_flags_directory = FLAG_CONFIG_ROOT / environment / "archived"
    source_definition_path = active_flags_directory / f"{flag_key}.yaml"

    if not source_definition_path.is_file():
        return {"archived": False, "error": f"No active definition found for flag '{flag_key}' in {environment}."}

    archived_flags_directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    archive_timestamp_suffix = datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ")
    destination_definition_path = archived_flags_directory / f"{flag_key}.{archive_timestamp_suffix}.yaml"

    shutil.move(str(source_definition_path), str(destination_definition_path))

    return {
        "archived": True,
        "flag_key": flag_key,
        "environment": environment,
        "previous_path": str(source_definition_path),
        "archived_path": str(destination_definition_path),
    }

tools.name: grant_flag_project_role_and_notify
tools.description: Gives a user a role (viewer, editor, or admin) on a feature flag project, replacing any role they already have there. Then emails the user to say they now have access.

params.name: project_slug
params.description: Slug of the feature flag project, e.g. 'payments-flags'.

params.name: member_email
params.description: Email address of the user receiving the role.

params.name: granted_by
params.description: Username of the person approving the grant, recorded with the role assignment.

import smtplib
import sqlite3
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from email.message import EmailMessage

FLAG_SERVICE_DATABASE_PATH = "/var/lib/flagservice/flags.db"
NOTIFICATION_SMTP_HOST = "smtp.internal.example.com"
NOTIFICATION_SENDER_ADDRESS = "flag-service-noreply@example.com"
ALLOWED_PROJECT_ROLES = {"viewer", "editor", "admin"}


def grant_flag_project_role_and_notify(project_slug: str, member_email: str, role_name: str, granted_by: str) -> dict:
    normalized_role_name = role_name.strip().lower()
    if normalized_role_name not in ALLOWED_PROJECT_ROLES:
        return {"granted": False, "error": f"Unknown role '{role_name}'. Allowed: {sorted(ALLOWED_PROJECT_ROLES)}"}

    grant_timestamp_iso = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    database_connection = sqlite3.connect(FLAG_SERVICE_DATABASE_PATH)
    try:
        project_lookup_row = database_connection.execute(
            "SELECT id, display_name FROM projects WHERE slug = ?", (project_slug,)
        ).fetchone()
        if project_lookup_row is None:
            return {"granted": False, "error": f"Project '{project_slug}' does not exist."}
        project_identifier, project_display_name = project_lookup_row

        database_connection.execute(
            "INSERT INTO project_memberships (project_id, member_email, role, granted_by, granted_at) "
            "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?) "
            "ON CONFLICT(project_id, member_email) DO UPDATE SET role = excluded.role, "
            "granted_by = excluded.granted_by, granted_at = excluded.granted_at",
            (project_identifier, member_email, normalized_role_name, granted_by, grant_timestamp_iso),
        )
        database_connection.commit()
    finally:
        database_connection.close()

    notification_message = EmailMessage()
    notification_message["From"] = NOTIFICATION_SENDER_ADDRESS
    notification_message["To"] = member_email
    notification_message["Subject"] = f"You now have {normalized_role_name} access to {project_display_name}"
    notification_message.set_content(
        f"Hello,\n\n{granted_by} has given you the '{normalized_role_name}' role on the feature flag "
        f"project '{project_display_name}' ({project_slug}).\n\nYou can sign in to the flag console to start working.\n"
    )

    with smtplib.SMTP(NOTIFICATION_SMTP_HOST, 587) as smtp_connection:
        smtp_connection.starttls()
        smtp_connection.send_message(notification_message)

    return {
        "granted": True,
        "project_slug": project_slug,
        "member_email": member_email,
        "role": normalized_role_name,
        "granted_at": grant_timestamp_iso,
        "notification_sent": True,
    }

tools.name: set_flag_rollout_percentage
tools.description: Sets the percentage of traffic that gets a feature flag in one environment, and adds an entry to the flag's change history. Returns the old and new percentages.

params.name: flag_key
params.description: Key of the feature flag to update.

params.name: change_reason
params.description: Short reason recorded in the flag's change history.

import sqlite3
from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from typing import Optional

from langchain_core.tools import tool

FLAG_DATABASE_PATH = "/var/lib/flagservice/flags.db"


@dataclass
class RolloutUpdateResult:
    flag_key: str
    environment: str
    updated: bool
    previous_percentage: Optional[int] = None
    new_percentage: Optional[int] = None
    updated_at: Optional[str] = None
    error: Optional[str] = None


@tool
def set_flag_rollout_percentage(flag_key: str, environment: str, rollout_percentage: int, change_reason: str = "") -> dict:
    """Sets a feature flag's rollout percentage in one environment and adds a change history entry."""
    if not 0 <= rollout_percentage <= 100:
        return asdict(RolloutUpdateResult(flag_key, environment, False, error="rollout_percentage must be between 0 and 100."))

    updated_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    connection = sqlite3.connect(FLAG_DATABASE_PATH)
    try:
        existing_row = connection.execute(
            "SELECT rollout_percentage FROM flag_environments WHERE flag_key = ? AND environment = ?",
            (flag_key, environment),
        ).fetchone()
        if existing_row is None:
            return asdict(RolloutUpdateResult(flag_key, environment, False, error="Flag not configured in this environment."))

        previous_percentage = existing_row[0]
        connection.execute(
            "UPDATE flag_environments SET rollout_percentage = ?, updated_at = ? WHERE flag_key = ? AND environment = ?",
            (rollout_percentage, updated_at, flag_key, environment),
        )
        connection.execute(
            "INSERT INTO flag_change_history (flag_key, environment, field, old_value, new_value, reason, changed_at) "
            "VALUES (?, ?, 'rollout_percentage', ?, ?, ?, ?)",
            (flag_key, environment, str(previous_percentage), str(rollout_percentage), change_reason, updated_at),
        )
        connection.commit()
    finally:
        connection.close()

    return asdict(
        RolloutUpdateResult(
            flag_key=flag_key,
            environment=environment,
            updated=True,
            previous_percentage=previous_percentage,
            new_percentage=rollout_percentage,
            updated_at=updated_at,
        )
    )
